findings.text: the claim "every candidate has one row here" is false: an independent extraction of skills/reckon-build/SKILL.md at 7c25dee7 finds 544 non-heading sentences and 244 modal/imperative candidates, and at least seven of them have no row anywhere in the table — SKILL.md:143 "Read it first - ALL of it.", :201 "Trust pending_work rather than recounting." (item 1 of the numbered binding list, and the string pending_work occurs zero times in the artifact), :243 item 16 "Drain followups and live run pointers before closure, and sign both.", :327-329 the prior-art scout whose single deliverable is a REUSE MAP, :514 "State what the node is; reckon resolves how it runs.", :958 "Keep the horizon advancing", :1172 "Keep this copy in sync." — each matching the node's own stated candidate rule, so the completeness measure the done_when rests on does not hold.

the subtitle states "of 550 prose sentences; 197 keyword/imperative candidates", contradicting the 240 its own title and bars report and the 240 the fragment's prose and table report, so one delivered measurement carries two totals and a reader cannot tell which governs the review's disposition vector.

the done_when asks enforced rows to name the test run in the foreground with its log cited, but the only log reference in the artifact is the bare directory "logs/", which resolves to none of the five logs the run produced (logs/gate-enforced-rules.log, gate-refusals.log, gate-baseline-enforcement.log, gate-head-enforcement.log, and the manifest's test_logs), and no row names a log file at all.
